name: Shiori
message: "Oh, don't worry. I'm still alive."

name: Shiori
message: "Ehehe, we've had this conversation before, haven't we? I'm fully conscious. Just playing dead like always."

name: Shiori
message: "Hey, could take you my photo?"
(Hold up your smartphone)

name: Shiori
message: "Thank you. Give me a sec, I'll set the mood."

name: Shiori
message: "...Okay, this should be good. Go ahead."
(Take a photo)

name: Shiori
message: "Thanks. I'm sure you can guess, but..."

name: Shiori
message: "Ah, right. I don't really need to play dead anymore."

name: Shiori
message: "Whew... Did I startle you? Sorry about that."

name: Shiori
message: "I finally remember. My final moments. And since I had the chance, I thought I'd have you take my photo."

name: Shiori
message: "That's why I asked you to come here instead of the usual park."

name: Shiori
message: "You looked genuinely surprised. Ah... right, I got myself stabbed yesterday. Of course you'd be. I'm sorry."

name: Shiori
message: "Shall we sit? There's so much I want to talk about."
(Sit on the bench)

name: Shiori
message: "There we go."

name: Shiori
message: "When that man stabbed me yesterday, a lot of memories came flooding back."

name: Shiori
message: "You know how I figured that if I reenacted the way I died, my memories might come back? Looks like I was right. Ehehe."

name: Shiori
message: "I assumed it was an accident, so I never imagined I'd actually been murdered..."

name: Shiori
message: "I mean, a murder case would definitely have made the news, right? But no matter how much we searched, nothing came up."

name: Shiori
message: "It was five years ago, so maybe we just weren't searching properly... or maybe my name was withheld..."

name: Shiori
message: "Could it have been kept quiet because I might've been seen as an accomplice? Or maybe his father's influence had it covered up."

name: Shiori
message: "If we search again now, maybe we'll finally find an article about me."

name: Shiori
message: "But now I know how I died, so there's no need for that anymore."

name: Shiori
message: "I wasn't fixated on the case because I was Girl A. It was because I got caught up in it and died."

name: Shiori
message: "If I remember correctly, everyone was on edge back then. After all, five kids had been killed."

name: Shiori
message: "When it was just the first one, it still felt like someone else's problem. It was scary, terrible, and that was it."

name: Shiori
message: "But when the second body was found, people started getting scared. For all they knew, their kids could've been next."

name: Shiori
message: "Now I know this is going to sound like I'm blaming my mom, but..."

name: Shiori
message: "You see, Mom always said that kids were meant to play outside."

name: Shiori
message: "So she felt bad keeping my sister cooped up at home all the time. Even though she didn't even like running around outside, ehehe."

name: Shiori
message: "When I'd get back from school, Mom would tell me to take her out to play. She was confident my sister would be safe as long as I was with her."

name: Shiori
message: "And I felt the same. I thought I was being careful, that I was keeping an eye out for suspicious people, but..."

name: Shiori
message: "I didn't even notice he'd already set his sights on us, that he was stalking us."

name: Shiori
message: "People knew he was always leering in the park, but I never even remembered him."

name: Shiori
message: "If some strange man had been staring at us, I'd think I would've noticed... Maybe he was watching us from somewhere out of sight."

name: Shiori
message: "Ah... you know how this park is always empty? Maybe it's not the lack of equipment. Maybe it's just because of him."

name: Shiori
message: "...That has to be it. If there was some creepy guy around, word would've spread among the kids in the neighborhood."

name: Shiori
message: "But back then, I didn't know anything. I just thought, 'Fewer people, lucky us! She can play without worrying.'"

name: Shiori
message: "I thought crowded places were more dangerous. She wasn't the type to run off on her own, but you never know what might happen."

name: Shiori
message: "I was terrified of the possibility that she'd get lost in the crowd, or even kidnapped."

name: Shiori
message: "In a way, I was so tense that every time we went out, I'd come home exhausted."

name: Shiori
message: "By the time the third or fourth victim appeared, even Mom stopped telling me to take her out to play, but..."

name: Shiori
message: "...but... on that day..."

name: Shiori
message: "Never mind. Let's set that aside for now."

name: Shiori
message: "Anyway, I remembered. A lot."

name: Shiori
message: "But... there are still a few things that aren't completely clear."

name: Shiori
message: "So today, I'd like to walk around town and sort through my memories. With you."

name: Shiori
message: "I also want to say thanks to the people who've helped me so far."

name: Shiori
message: "Alright, let's go~!"
